options: Programs can choose different actions based on a condition. `if (isRaining) { bringUmbrella(); }` runs an action only when the condition is true. A function is a named set of instructions you can run when needed. It is like a recipe: give it inputs and it follows steps. Functions help reuse behavior and make a program easier to read.
